content_sources.title: @levelsio: 🕹️ THE VIBE JAM IS BACK! I present you... 🌟 2026 @cursor_ai Vibe Coding Game Jam #vibejam Sponsored by @boltdotnew + @cursor_ai Start: Tod
content_sources.description:
🕹️ THE VIBE JAM IS BACK!

I present you...

🌟 2026 @cursor_ai Vibe Coding Game Jam #vibejam

Sponsored by @boltdotnew + @cursor_ai

Start: Today!

Deadline: 1 May 2026 at 13:37 UTC, so you have a whole month to make your game!

REAL CASH PRIZES:

🏆 Gold: $20,000

🥈 Silver: $10,000

🥉 Bronze: $5,000

RULES:
- anyone can enter with their game
- at least 90% of code has to be written by AI 
- it should be started today or after today, don't submit old games
- game has to be accessible on web without any login or signup and free-to-play (preferrably its own domain or subdomain)
- multiplayer games preferred but not required!
- can use any engine but usually @ThreeJS is recommended
- NO loading screens and heavy downloads (!!!) has to be almost instantly in the game (except maybe ask username if you want)
- add the HTML code on the Google form in the reply below to show you're an entrant
- one entry per person (focus on making one really good game!)

WHAT TO USE:
- anythign but we suggest @cursor_ai's Composer 3 and @boltdotnew, they are both fast, affordable and great at ThreeJS and making games

THE JURY:
Me, @s13k_, and I will ask some real game dev and AI people to jury again too

Sponsors and jury suggestions still very welcome, just DM me!

It will be interesting to see the difference in quality with last year, and the Vibe Jam can be kind of like a fun benchmark for AI coding seeing it close in on real commercial games I think

To enter, complete the form in the reply below this tweet!

autoresearch.research_question: What happens when collecting and copying stop preserving an image and start turning it into a strange, worn-out character of its own?
autoresearch.synthesis: The strongest fresh, evidenced artwork is @planet_nerf's supermodel: a strip of blurred cartoon-like figures with sunglasses, oversized ears, candy colors and unstable contours. Its accompanying text describes recursive training on its own output; the inspected image makes that recursion tangible as color bleed and damaged recognition rather than a technology diagram. Number Research Inc. offers an adjacent comic ritual: collecting numbers as if an impossible inventory were ordinary office work. Together they suggest a small, deliberately imperfect world of repeated characters and futile collecting. Zoomquilt and Visual Instruments offer promising extensions through continuous transformation and image-to-sound interaction, but their actual media surfaces remain unverified. This is an underfilled research result, not a publish-ready edition: the fresh eligible selection is deliberately smaller than the requested target rather than padded with previously used music, unavailable pages or agent tutorials.
autoresearch.edition_thesis: Copies with bad memories: cartoon residue meets the absurd collector.
autoresearch.aesthetic_thesis: An imagined scuffed cartoon print, washed in aquarium blue, faded coral and murky green, where swollen character silhouettes and imperfect registration become the edges of a small collecting game.
visual_motifs: Aquarium-blue fields interrupted by faded coral-red shapes
Soft, swollen cartoon ears and uncertain facial contours
Dark sunglasses as compact horizontal cuts through hazy color
Green and pink color bleed around barely aligned outlines
Repeated figures that change rather than match
Smudged print-like texture and low-contrast image residue
A held playing card as a small collecting gesture
Broad quiet gaps between irregular silhouettes, not a grid of interface cards
autoresearch.anchor_reason: Select https://x.com/planet_nerf/status/2052266270884855886 as the anchor. It is a non-duplicate, renderable artwork post from the supplied Twitter-bookmark channel, not a product tutorial. Its attached image was inspected directly: four adjacent cartoon-like figures share blurred edges, conspicuous ears, dark eyewear, reds, greens and blues, with differing degrees of degradation. Those visible properties provide a specific grammar for the plate. Borrow the softened contours, color contamination and imperfect repetition; do not reproduce the character lineup, weapons or portrait compositions. The post's recursive-training account supplies context, not independently verified technical evidence.

clusters.label: A copy loses its bearings
clusters.takeaway: The selected anchor turns recursive image-making into a visibly unstable cartoon surface. Let that surface determine the plate rather than illustrating an AI workflow.

clusters.label: The impossible collection
clusters.takeaway: Number Research Inc. supplies a dry comic counterpoint: a participatory inventory that cannot be finished. Use its actual attached artifact, not an invented numbered-card interface.

clusters.label: Transformation as a browsing gesture
clusters.takeaway: Research-only extensions: extracted text confirms Zoomquilt as a collaborative infinitely zooming painting and Visual Instruments as an image-to-music experience. Internet Flowers has a strong saved description of collecting found flower images. None is promoted to a content window without media verification.

source_decisions.why: Anchor and primary visual reference. Supplied evidence marks it renderable and non-duplicate; direct inspection confirms an artwork strip with smeared cartoon figures rather than tooling chrome. Saved Twitter-bookmark provenance dated 2026-05-08.

Non-duplicate renderable art-comedy post about an impossible participatory number archive. Supplies a distinct collecting ritual rather than a second generative-image demonstration. Saved Twitter-bookmark provenance dated 2026-03-03; attached image suitability still requires visual capture.

Live extraction confirms the collaborative infinitely zooming painting and names its illustrators. Strong transformation reference from a June saved signal, but no main artwork frame was inspected or verified for a window.

Live extraction identifies Visual Instruments, an exploration of making music from images, with click-to-activate sound and a desktop preference. Strong potential sonic extension; canvas imagery, audio and mobile behavior remain unverified.

The saved creator account describes a garden assembled from found flower images, making this a strong collecting-related artwork lead. Extraction failed and the browser service was unavailable, so neither its current image surface nor its readiness was established.

A relatively recent saved artist-collection signal worth recovering before older tooling. Candidate evidence is a security checkpoint and the new extraction failed; the title alone cannot establish a lavender palette, game aesthetic or renderable artwork.
Live extraction confirms mathematical-art and physics explorations, but exposes no specific inspected work suitable for this plate. Do not use the extracted portrait as a substitute for an artwork.
A specific material object could add a useful printed-to-woven translation, but the supplied page is a challenge screen and contains no verified object imagery. Do not invent its pattern.
A specific object reference, currently blocked and unverified. Shares the rug's artist and note cluster, so both should not be promoted merely to inflate variety.
Excellent recent musical signal, but explicitly marked as a recent duplicate and its embed is unavailable. Do not reuse it to make this edition appear musically richer.
Same release family as the excluded Flying Saucer Attack and Roy Montgomery video, with a challenge page and no image evidence. A different domain does not make the material fresh.
Recent Flying Saucer Attack listening signal, but explicitly duplicate. Recency does not override the one-use material constraint.
The forgotten-CD ambient collection is attractive editorially but already marked duplicate.
Naturewave would offer an easy atmospheric bridge, but the supplied evidence marks this source as already used.
Already-used Ikeda material with an unavailable embed; do not substitute a thumbnail for playable music.
Alternate page for the excluded Ikeda release family; only redirect evidence, without fresh artwork.
A channel page inherited the Daniel Avery session's note title. It is not the saved performance and has no renderable surface in the supplied evidence.
Security-checkpoint evidence and a pipeline recovery-seed note do not verify the claimed artwork or establish a fresh editorial save.
The supplied result is Page Not Found. Botanical wording in a recovery-seed note cannot supply missing plate imagery.
Confirmed missing-page evidence in the payload, with no actual garden imagery. Not a substitute source window.
An emergency demo-image seed, explicitly duplicate. Renderability alone is not editorial provenance.
A compelling illustration archive but already marked duplicate. Its short-link aliases cannot restore eligibility.
Material-rich art portfolio, but explicitly duplicate; do not recycle it as a supposedly fresh dominant image.
An image-to-3D production-pipeline post with unverified media eligibility. The present evidence does not justify making it a loud creative window.
Same source family as the pipeline post, without verified standalone artwork capture. Do not count both the demonstration and its parent.
Game-interface generation tutorial, not an established artwork selection. A video thumbnail and creative-art score do not override the false renderability flag.
Agent-operated TouchDesigner promotion. The credited artwork could merit separate inspection, but the current candidate evidence does not establish a fresh eligible artwork surface.
Auxiliary-model cost-saving tutorial. Its YouTube thumbnail does not turn agent infrastructure into music or visual culture.
Autocritic is a system for steering generation; references to art theorists are not evidence of a suitable original visual artifact. Authorless and short-link variants are the same family.

Hiroo Isono is a compelling art lead, but this candidate is an unresolved short link. The attached image URLs mentioned in the note are not standalone candidate entries, so they cannot be silently substituted.
The cowboy-oyster menu could provide excellent drawing and humor, but the listed source remains unresolved. Do not select an imagined menu capture.
The USB-C connector artwork has strong material specificity, but its candidate URL is unresolved and its attached photograph is not a selectable standalone candidate.
Cassette-futurist world-building is promising, but this is unresolved-link evidence without a captured work.
Malformed URL with trailing Markdown punctuation, pointing to a profile rather than a specific saved zine image. Do not repair the token silently or infer a renderable post.
Unavailable video with generic metadata and no verified title or media. A playlist inventory entry is insufficient evidence.
Unavailable video with generic metadata; do not assign an invented musical identity.
Document-parsing infrastructure, not a visual artwork or material reference.
SEO guidance without a relevant visual artifact.
Administrative survey, not a public artwork surface.

The article has a real photographic lead, but its older policy-news provenance and data-center subject do not support the chosen visual world. Exclude rather than stretch the thesis for domain variety.

capture_notes: Selection is intentionally underfilled. Do not treat this JSON as satisfying the production source floor. Recover more eligible art/media candidates or return the run for source research; do not fill empty windows with summaries.

The anchor image was directly inspected. Preserve its attached-media provenance and verify image decoding and resolution in the source window. Its appearance supports blurred cartoon residue, not a claim that its physical medium is paint or print.

Inspect Number Research Inc.'s attached image before packaging. The payload marks it renderable, but this pass did not visually verify that attachment. If it is only text or generic app chrome without sufficient artistic value, remove the window rather than replace it with a fabricated card.

Research extraction recovered readable descriptions for Zoomquilt and Visual Instruments, not verified main-artwork captures. The browser service could not connect, so no browser-based rendering, audio or mobile proof was obtained.

For Zoomquilt, capture the painting itself after animation starts, with creator credits retained in provenance. Do not use app-store badges, links to other projects or promotional thumbnails as the source image.

For Visual Instruments, verify a real rendered image-to-sound interaction, user-gesture audio activation and mobile behavior. Its extracted page explicitly recommends a computer and landscape orientation.
Retry Internet Flowers and Lavender Town through the capture harness before promoting either. A saved description or collection title must not stand in for an observed artwork.
Keep the literal candidate URL as the selected identifier. Record redirect targets separately and deduplicate by parent page, post ID, media and underlying work.
Recheck the selected post families and attached media against the full archive ledger; recent_duplicate=false in this payload is not an independent all-history verification.

If fresh sources are recovered, favor genuine music or image-led work from another channel. No new music window was selected here because the evidenced music candidates were duplicated, unavailable or not specific playable works.

Derive invisible hover and tap territories from broad contour regions in the generated plate. Keep the live plate image-only; verify generous mobile media windows without clipping, review labels or debug outlines.
rejected_patterns: Reusing already-published music, paintings, game pages or media through an alternate domain or short-link alias
Treating renderable_surface=false as proof that a source has usable media
Mistaking a channel or profile page for the specific work named in its parent note
Promoting AI tutorials because their thumbnails contain colorful graphics or their notes mention art
Using recovery seeds, stock-demo rasters or emergency fill images as fresh saved cultural signals
Silently repairing malformed URLs or inventing standalone candidates from links buried in note excerpts
Using unresolved short links, missing pages and security checkpoints as content windows
Counting artist objects from one collection or duplicate post variants as independent editorial variety
Converting source titles into invented palettes, textures or artwork descriptions
Padding a thin but honest selection to nine sources with weakly related policy news, generic archives or administrative pages
Using logos, badges, default social previews and text-only cards as substitutes for real artwork
Claiming browser capture, native-player availability or publication readiness without execution proof
autoresearch.workflow: aesthetic-field autoresearch: read all candidate source evidence, find the most visually fertile creative through-line, imagine the edition as a coherent aesthetic world, choose renderable source windows with provenance, and avoid infrastructure/tooling links unless they carry strong visible artifacts.
